root.help:
Unified management for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and OpenCode CLI provider configurations, MCP
servers, skills, prompts, local proxy routes, and environment checks.

Run without arguments to enter interactive mode.

Usage: cc-switch [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  auth         Manage ChatGPT Codex OAuth accounts
  provider     Manage providers (list, switch, export, speedtest, stream-check, fetch-models, quota)
  use          Switch to a provider (shortcut for `provider switch <id>`)
  mcp          Manage MCP servers (list, add, edit, delete, sync)
  prompts      Manage prompts (list, current, live, import, activate, create, rename, edit)
  skills       Manage skills and skill repositories
  config       Manage configuration, backups, common snippets, and WebDAV sync
  proxy        Manage local multi-app proxy
  settings     Manage persisted UI and integration settings
  failover     Manage automatic failover and provider queue
  sessions     Manage saved assistant sessions
  hermes       Hermes-specific commands (memory blobs etc.)
  start        Start an app with a provider selector without switching the global current provider
  daemon       Manage the cc-switch supervisor daemon (start/stop/status/logs)
  env          Manage environment variables and local CLI tool checks
  deeplink     Import a resource (provider/mcp/prompt/skill) from a ccswitch:// deep link URL
  update       Update cc-switch binary to latest release
  interactive  Enter interactive mode
  completions  Generate, install, inspect, or uninstall shell completions
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -a, --app <APP>
          Specify the application type
          
          [possible values: claude, codex, gemini, open-code, hermes, open-claw, pi]

  -v, --verbose
          Enable verbose output

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version

start.help:
Start an app with a provider selector without switching the global current provider

Usage: cc-switch start [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  claude  Start Claude with a provider selector without switching the global current provider
  codex   Start Codex with a provider selector without switching the global current provider
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -a, --app <APP>  Specify the application type [possible values: claude, codex, gemini, open-code,
                   hermes, open-claw, pi]
  -v, --verbose    Enable verbose output
  -h, --help       Print help

start-claude.help:
Start Claude with a provider selector without switching the global current provider

Usage: cc-switch start claude [OPTIONS] <SELECTOR> [-- <NATIVE_ARGS>...]

Arguments:
  <SELECTOR>
          Provider selector: exact ID first, then exact Name

  [NATIVE_ARGS]...
          Native Claude CLI arguments to pass through after `--`

Options:
  -a, --app <APP>
          Specify the application type
          
          [possible values: claude, codex, gemini, open-code, hermes, open-claw, pi]

      --dry-run
          Preview the resolved launch without starting Claude

  -v, --verbose
          Enable verbose output

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  cc-switch start claude demo
  cc-switch start claude demo --dry-run
  cc-switch start claude demo -- --dangerously-skip-permissions

common.help:
Manage common configuration snippet (per app)

Usage: cc-switch config common [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  show     Show current common config snippet
  format   Format a common config snippet and print the normalized result
  extract  Extract a common config snippet from a provider or settings payload
  set      Set common config snippet for the selected app
  clear    Clear common config snippet for the selected app
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -a, --app <APP>  Specify the application type [possible values: claude, codex, gemini, open-code,
                   hermes, open-claw, pi]
  -v, --verbose    Enable verbose output
  -h, --help       Print help

common-set.help:
Set common config snippet for the selected app

Usage: cc-switch config common set [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -a, --app <APP>
          Specify the application type
          
          [possible values: claude, codex, gemini, open-code, hermes, open-claw, pi]

      --snippet <SNIPPET>
          Inline snippet text (Claude/Gemini/OpenCode: JSON object; Codex: TOML)

      --file <FILE>
          Read snippet text from file using the selected app's format rules

  -v, --verbose
          Enable verbose output

      --apply
          Compatibility flag; changes already try to refresh the current live config when applicable

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Compatibility:
  --json <SNIPPET>  Legacy alias for --snippet <SNIPPET>.

provider.help:
Manage providers (list, switch, export, speedtest, stream-check, fetch-models, quota)

Usage: cc-switch provider [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list                List all providers
  current             Show current provider
  switch              Switch to a provider
  add                 Add a new provider (non-interactive; use the TUI for interactive add)
  edit                Edit a provider
  delete              Delete a provider
  duplicate           Duplicate a provider
  import-live         Import providers from the current live app config
  remove-from-config  Remove a provider from additive live app config without deleting it
  set-default         Set the default provider/model for apps that support it
  speedtest           Test provider endpoint speed
  stream-check        Run stream health check for a provider
  fetch-models        Fetch remote model list for a provider
  quota               Query provider quota or usage
  usage-query         Configure provider Usage Query
  export              Export a Claude provider to a standalone settings file
  help                Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -a, --app <APP>  Specify the application type [possible values: claude, codex, gemini, open-code,
                   hermes, open-claw, pi]
  -v, --verbose    Enable verbose output
  -h, --help       Print help
